results.rationale: Front-end is the IVD initiator with highest Copeland score (3), indicating its anomaly is least explainable by others and most explanatory for downstream components. It exhibits strong near-onset internal mechanism: memory spike, CPU drop, and emitter exception logs (PaymentDeclinedException) at 1732258812. The 406 errors it reports from orders are dependency failures, not root causes. Orders, despite its own anomalies, is an IVD victim; its errors are explained by front-end’s upstream fault. Storage components show reactive resource pressure typical of dependency load. Queue-master’s I/O exception is ambiguous and lacks propagation linkage to the primary failure. No other candidate matches the combination of early onset, emitter-side mechanism, and broad explanatory coverage.
uncertainties: Queue-master's I/O exception is unexplained but likely independent and not causal to the main incident.
